---- MODULE etcd_raft ----
EXTENDS etcd_raftDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
(***************************************************************************)
(* Basic value sets.  The only entry-creating action is ClientRequest(i,0),*)
(* so every log entry has the shape                                        *)
(*    [term |-> t, type |-> ValueEntry, value |-> [val |-> 0]] ,           *)
(* i.e. an entry is completely determined by its term.                     *)
(***************************************************************************)
ZEntry == [term : Nat, type : {ValueEntry}, value : {[val |-> 0]}]
ZConf  == [jointConfig |-> <<InitServer, {}>>, learners |-> {}]
ZSub   == {"app", "heartbeat", "snapshot"}
ZDState == [currentTerm : Nat, votedFor : Server \cup {Nil}, log : Nat,
            logEntries : Seq(ZEntry), commitIndex : Nat, config : {ZConf}]
ZMsgRVq == [mtype : {RequestVoteRequest}, mterm : Nat, mlastLogTerm : Nat,
            mlastLogIndex : Nat, msource : Server, mdest : Server]
ZMsgRVp == [mtype : {RequestVoteResponse}, mterm : Nat, mvoteGranted : BOOLEAN,
            msource : Server, mdest : Server]
ZMsgAEq == [mtype : {AppendEntriesRequest}, msubtype : ZSub, mterm : Nat,
            mprevLogIndex : Nat, mprevLogTerm : Nat, mentries : Seq(ZEntry),
            mcommitIndex : Nat, msource : Server, mdest : Server]
ZMsgAEp == [mtype : {AppendEntriesResponse}, msubtype : ZSub, mterm : Nat,
            msuccess : BOOLEAN, mmatchIndex : Nat, msource : Server, mdest : Server]
ZMsg == ZMsgRVq \cup ZMsgRVp \cup ZMsgAEq \cup ZMsgAEp

ZMsgs == (DOMAIN messages) \cup (DOMAIN pendingMessages)

ZTypeOK ==
  /\ IsABag(messages)
  /\ IsABag(pendingMessages)
  /\ DOMAIN messages \subseteq ZMsg
  /\ DOMAIN pendingMessages \subseteq ZMsg
  /\ currentTerm \in [Server -> Nat]
  /\ state \in [Server -> {Follower, Candidate, Leader}]
  /\ votedFor \in [Server -> Server \cup {Nil}]
  /\ log \in [Server -> Seq(ZEntry)]
  /\ commitIndex \in [Server -> Nat]
  /\ votesResponded \in [Server -> SUBSET Server]
  /\ votesGranted \in [Server -> SUBSET Server]
  /\ matchIndex \in [Server -> [Server -> Nat]]
  /\ pendingConfChangeIndex \in [Server -> Nat]
  /\ config = [i \in Server |-> ZConf]
  /\ durableState \in [Server -> ZDState]

(***************************************************************************)
(* Library facts that cannot be cited directly.  Because of LOCAL INSTANCE *)
(* declarations on the EXTENDS path, the finite-set theorems of the        *)
(* standard library and the definition of bag difference are not usable    *)
(* as they stand; they are recovered through explicit instances plus       *)
(* bridging equalities.                                                    *)
(***************************************************************************)

LOCAL ZFS == INSTANCE FiniteSetTheorems
LOCAL ZBT == INSTANCE BagsTheorems

(***************************************************************************)
(* Bags of messages: only the domains matter for the invariants.           *)
(***************************************************************************)

(***************************************************************************)
(* Min and Max.                                                            *)
(***************************************************************************)

(***************************************************************************)
(* The configuration never changes, so all quorums are quorums of          *)
(* InitServer.                                                             *)
(***************************************************************************)

(***************************************************************************)
(* Layer 1 of the inductive invariant: types, plus everything needed to    *)
(* establish that at most one server is Leader in any given term.          *)
(*                                                                         *)
(* ZVRec(j,t,c) records the (possibly indirect) evidence available in the  *)
(* current state that server j granted its vote to c in term t.  ZA12      *)
(* states that this evidence is unambiguous.                               *)
(***************************************************************************)

ZVRec(j, t, c) ==
   \/ (currentTerm[j] = t /\ votedFor[j] = c)
   \/ (durableState[j].currentTerm = t /\ durableState[j].votedFor = c)
   \/ (\E m \in DOMAIN messages : /\ m.mtype = RequestVoteResponse
                                  /\ m.mvoteGranted
                                  /\ m.msource = j /\ m.mterm = t /\ m.mdest = c)
   \/ (\E m \in DOMAIN pendingMessages : /\ m.mtype = RequestVoteResponse
                                         /\ m.mvoteGranted
                                         /\ m.msource = j /\ m.mterm = t /\ m.mdest = c)
   \/ (state[c] # Follower /\ currentTerm[c] = t /\ j \in votesGranted[c])

ZA1 == \A i \in Server : durableState[i].currentTerm <= currentTerm[i]
ZA2 == \A i \in Server : state[i] # Follower => i \in InitServer
ZA3 == \A m \in ZMsgs : m.msource \in InitServer /\ m.mdest \in InitServer
ZA4 == \A m \in ZMsgs : m.mtype = RequestVoteRequest => m.msource # m.mdest
ZA5 == \A i \in Server : state[i] # Follower => votedFor[i] = i
ZA6 == \A i \in Server : currentTerm[i] = durableState[i].currentTerm =>
                            durableState[i].votedFor \in {Nil, votedFor[i]}
ZA7 == \A m \in DOMAIN pendingMessages :
          (m.mtype = RequestVoteResponse /\ m.mvoteGranted) =>
             /\ m.mterm <= currentTerm[m.msource]
             /\ (m.mterm = currentTerm[m.msource] => votedFor[m.msource] = m.mdest)
ZA8 == \A m \in DOMAIN messages :
          (m.mtype = RequestVoteResponse /\ m.mvoteGranted) =>
             /\ m.mterm <= durableState[m.msource].currentTerm
             /\ (m.mterm = durableState[m.msource].currentTerm =>
                    durableState[m.msource].votedFor = m.mdest)
ZA9 == \A c \in Server : state[c] # Follower =>
          \A j \in votesGranted[c] :
             /\ currentTerm[c] <= durableState[j].currentTerm
             /\ (currentTerm[c] = durableState[j].currentTerm =>
                    durableState[j].votedFor = c)
ZA10 == \A i \in Server : state[i] = Leader => votesGranted[i] \in Quorum(InitServer)
ZA11 == \A i \in Server : votesGranted[i] \subseteq InitServer
ZA12 == \A j \in Server, t \in Nat, c1, c2 \in Server :
            ZVRec(j,t,c1) /\ ZVRec(j,t,c2) => c1 = c2

ZInd1 == /\ ZTypeOK
         /\ ZA1 /\ ZA2 /\ ZA3 /\ ZA4 /\ ZA5 /\ ZA6
         /\ ZA7 /\ ZA8 /\ ZA9 /\ ZA10 /\ ZA11 /\ ZA12

ZNewOK(mm) ==
   /\ mm \in ZMsg
   /\ mm.msource \in InitServer /\ mm.mdest \in InitServer
   /\ (mm.mtype = RequestVoteRequest => mm.msource # mm.mdest)
   /\ ((mm.mtype = RequestVoteResponse /\ mm.mvoteGranted) =>
         (mm.mterm = currentTerm[mm.msource] /\ votedFor[mm.msource] = mm.mdest))

(***************************************************************************)
(* Inductive step for ZInd1.  ZKeep collects the variables that all the    *)
(* "framed" actions leave untouched, ZTyRest the typing of the remaining   *)
(* ones.                                                                   *)
(***************************************************************************)

ZKeep == /\ currentTerm' = currentTerm
         /\ state' = state
         /\ votedFor' = votedFor
         /\ votesGranted' = votesGranted
         /\ durableState' = durableState
         /\ config' = config

ZTyRest == /\ votesResponded' \in [Server -> SUBSET Server]
           /\ log' \in [Server -> Seq(ZEntry)]
           /\ commitIndex' \in [Server -> Nat]
           /\ matchIndex' \in [Server -> [Server -> Nat]]
           /\ pendingConfChangeIndex' \in [Server -> Nat]

(***************************************************************************)
(* A server steps down: state[i] becomes Follower, nothing else that the   *)
(* vote invariants mention changes.                                        *)
(***************************************************************************)

(***************************************************************************)
(* Individual actions.                                                     *)
(***************************************************************************)


LEMMA ZBridges ==
  /\ lb1 :: \A S : ZFS!Cardinality(S) = Cardinality(S)
  /\ lb2 :: \A S : ZFS!IsFiniteSet(S) <=> IsFiniteSet(S)
  /\ lb3 :: \A bb : ZBT!IsABag(bb) <=> IsABag(bb)
  /\ lb4 :: \A bb, cc : ZBT!(-)(bb, cc) = bb (-) cc
  /\ lb5 :: \A bb, cc : ZBT!(+)(bb, cc) = bb (+) cc
  <1>1. \A S : ZFS!Cardinality(S) = Cardinality(S)
    BY DEF ZFS!Cardinality, Cardinality
  <1>2. \A S : ZFS!IsFiniteSet(S) <=> IsFiniteSet(S)
    BY DEF ZFS!IsFiniteSet, IsFiniteSet
  <1>3. \A bb : ZBT!IsABag(bb) <=> IsABag(bb)
    BY DEF ZBT!IsABag, IsABag
  <1>4. \A bb, cc : ZBT!(-)(bb, cc) = bb (-) cc
    BY DEF ZBT!(-), (-)
  <1>5. \A bb, cc : ZBT!(+)(bb, cc) = bb (+) cc
    BY DEF ZBT!(+), (+)
  <1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5

LEMMA ZFinFacts ==
  /\ lb1 :: (\A S : ((IsFiniteSet(S)) => (Cardinality(S) \in Nat)))
  /\ lb2 :: (\A S : ((IsFiniteSet(S)) => (\A T : ((T \subseteq S) => (IsFiniteSet(T) /\ Cardinality(T) <= Cardinality(S))))))
  /\ lb3 :: /\ IsFiniteSet({}) /\ Cardinality({}) = 0 /\ \A S : IsFiniteSet(S) => (Cardinality(S) = 0 <=> S = {})
  /\ lb4 :: (\A S : ((IsFiniteSet(S)) => (\A x : (/\ IsFiniteSet(S \cup {x}) /\ Cardinality(S \cup {x}) = IF x \in S THEN Cardinality(S) ELSE Cardinality(S)+1))))
  /\ lb5 :: (\A U : (\A S : (\A T : ((IsFiniteSet(U)) => ((S \subseteq U) => ((T \subseteq U) => ((Cardinality(S) + Cardinality(T) > Cardinality(U)) => (S \cap T # {}))))))))
  <1>1. (\A S : ((IsFiniteSet(S)) => (Cardinality(S) \in Nat)))
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW S, IsFiniteSet(S) PROVE Cardinality(S) \in Nat
      OBVIOUS
    <2> QED
      BY ZFS!FS_CardinalityType, ZBridges, ZBridges
  <1>2. (\A S : ((IsFiniteSet(S)) => (\A T : ((T \subseteq S) => (IsFiniteSet(T) /\ Cardinality(T) <= Cardinality(S))))))
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW S, IsFiniteSet(S), NEW T, T \subseteq S PROVE IsFiniteSet(T) /\ Cardinality(T) <= Cardinality(S)
      OBVIOUS
    <2> QED
      BY ZFS!FS_Subset, ZBridges, ZBridges
  <1>3. /\ IsFiniteSet({}) /\ Cardinality({}) = 0 /\ \A S : IsFiniteSet(S) => (Cardinality(S) = 0 <=> S = {})
    BY ZFS!FS_EmptySet, ZBridges, ZBridges
  <1>4. (\A S : ((IsFiniteSet(S)) => (\A x : (/\ IsFiniteSet(S \cup {x}) /\ Cardinality(S \cup {x}) = IF x \in S THEN Cardinality(S) ELSE Cardinality(S)+1))))
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW S, IsFiniteSet(S), NEW x PROVE /\ IsFiniteSet(S \cup {x}) /\ Cardinality(S \cup {x}) = IF x \in S THEN Cardinality(S) ELSE Cardinality(S)+1
      OBVIOUS
    <2> QED
      BY ZFS!FS_AddElement, ZBridges, ZBridges
  <1>5. (\A U : (\A S : (\A T : ((IsFiniteSet(U)) => ((S \subseteq U) => ((T \subseteq U) => ((Cardinality(S) + Cardinality(T) > Cardinality(U)) => (S \cap T # {}))))))))
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW U, NEW S, NEW T, IsFiniteSet(U), S \subseteq U, T \subseteq U, Cardinality(S) + Cardinality(T) > Cardinality(U) PROVE S \cap T # {}
      OBVIOUS
    <2> QED
      BY ZFS!FS_MajoritiesIntersect, ZBridges, ZBridges
  <1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5

LEMMA ZBagFacts ==
  /\ lb1 :: (\A bb : (\A cc : ((IsABag(bb)) => ((IsABag(cc)) => (/\ IsABag(bb (-) cc) /\ DOMAIN (bb (-) cc) = {e \in DOMAIN bb : e \notin DOMAIN cc \/ bb[e] > cc[e]})))))
  /\ lb2 :: (\A bb : (\A cc : ((IsABag(bb)) => ((IsABag(cc)) => (/\ IsABag(bb (+) cc) /\ DOMAIN (bb (+) cc) = DOMAIN bb \cup DOMAIN cc)))))
  /\ lb3 :: (\A S : (/\ IsABag(SetToBag(S)) /\ DOMAIN SetToBag(S) = S /\ \A e \in S : SetToBag(S)[e] = 1))
  /\ lb4 :: (\A mm : (\A bb : ((IsABag(bb)) => (/\ IsABag(WithMessage(mm, bb)) /\ DOMAIN WithMessage(mm, bb) = (DOMAIN bb) \cup {mm}))))
  /\ lb5 :: (\A mm : (\A bb : ((IsABag(bb)) => (/\ IsABag(WithoutMessage(mm, bb)) /\ DOMAIN WithoutMessage(mm, bb) \subseteq DOMAIN bb))))
  /\ lb6 :: IsABag(EmptyBag) /\ DOMAIN EmptyBag = {}
  <1>1. (\A bb : (\A cc : ((IsABag(bb)) => ((IsABag(cc)) => (/\ IsABag(bb (-) cc) /\ DOMAIN (bb (-) cc) = {e \in DOMAIN bb : e \notin DOMAIN cc \/ bb[e] > cc[e]})))))
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW bb, NEW cc, IsABag(bb), IsABag(cc) PROVE /\ IsABag(bb (-) cc) /\ DOMAIN (bb (-) cc) = {e \in DOMAIN bb : e \notin DOMAIN cc \/ bb[e] > cc[e]}
      OBVIOUS
    <2> QED
      BY ZBT!Bags_Difference, ZBridges, ZBridges
  <1>2. (\A bb : (\A cc : ((IsABag(bb)) => ((IsABag(cc)) => (/\ IsABag(bb (+) cc) /\ DOMAIN (bb (+) cc) = DOMAIN bb \cup DOMAIN cc)))))
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW bb, NEW cc, IsABag(bb), IsABag(cc) PROVE /\ IsABag(bb (+) cc) /\ DOMAIN (bb (+) cc) = DOMAIN bb \cup DOMAIN cc
      OBVIOUS
    <2> QED
      BY ZBT!Bags_Union, ZBridges, ZBridges
  <1>3. (\A S : (/\ IsABag(SetToBag(S)) /\ DOMAIN SetToBag(S) = S /\ \A e \in S : SetToBag(S)[e] = 1))
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW S PROVE /\ IsABag(SetToBag(S)) /\ DOMAIN SetToBag(S) = S /\ \A e \in S : SetToBag(S)[e] = 1
      OBVIOUS
    <2> QED
      BY DEF IsABag, SetToBag
  <1>4. (\A mm : (\A bb : ((IsABag(bb)) => (/\ IsABag(WithMessage(mm, bb)) /\ DOMAIN WithMessage(mm, bb) = (DOMAIN bb) \cup {mm}))))
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW mm, NEW bb, IsABag(bb) PROVE /\ IsABag(WithMessage(mm, bb)) /\ DOMAIN WithMessage(mm, bb) = (DOMAIN bb) \cup {mm}
      OBVIOUS
    <2> QED
      BY <1>3, <1>2 DEF WithMessage
  <1>5. (\A mm : (\A bb : ((IsABag(bb)) => (/\ IsABag(WithoutMessage(mm, bb)) /\ DOMAIN WithoutMessage(mm, bb) \subseteq DOMAIN bb))))
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW mm, NEW bb, IsABag(bb) PROVE /\ IsABag(WithoutMessage(mm, bb)) /\ DOMAIN WithoutMessage(mm, bb) \subseteq DOMAIN bb
      OBVIOUS
    <2> QED
      BY <1>3, <1>1 DEF WithoutMessage
  <1>6. IsABag(EmptyBag) /\ DOMAIN EmptyBag = {}
    BY <1>3 DEF EmptyBag
  <1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5, <1>6

LEMMA ZPendFacts ==
  /\ lb1 :: ((IsABag(pendingMessages)) => (\A i : (/\ IsABag(PendingMessages(i)) /\ DOMAIN PendingMessages(i) = {m \in DOMAIN pendingMessages : m.msource = i} /\ \A m \in DOMAIN PendingMessages(i) : PendingMessages(i)[m] = pendingMessages[m])))
  /\ lb2 :: ((IsABag(pendingMessages)) => (\A i : (/\ IsABag(ClearPendingMessages(i)) /\ DOMAIN ClearPendingMessages(i) = {m \in DOMAIN pendingMessages : m.msource # i})))
  /\ lb3 :: ((IsABag(pendingMessages)) => ((IsABag(messages)) => (\A i : (/\ IsABag(PendingMessages(i) (+) messages) /\ DOMAIN (PendingMessages(i) (+) messages) = {m \in DOMAIN pendingMessages : m.msource = i} \cup (DOMAIN messages) /\ IsABag(pendingMessages (-) PendingMessages(i)) /\ DOMAIN (pendingMessages (-) PendingMessages(i)) \subseteq DOMAIN pendingMessages))))
  <1>1. ((IsABag(pendingMessages)) => (\A i : (/\ IsABag(PendingMessages(i)) /\ DOMAIN PendingMessages(i) = {m \in DOMAIN pendingMessages : m.msource = i} /\ \A m \in DOMAIN PendingMessages(i) : PendingMessages(i)[m] = pendingMessages[m])))
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME IsABag(pendingMessages), NEW i PROVE /\ IsABag(PendingMessages(i)) /\ DOMAIN PendingMessages(i) = {m \in DOMAIN pendingMessages : m.msource = i} /\ \A m \in DOMAIN PendingMessages(i) : PendingMessages(i)[m] = pendingMessages[m]
      OBVIOUS
    <2> QED
      BY DEF PendingMessages, IsABag
  <1>2. ((IsABag(pendingMessages)) => (\A i : (/\ IsABag(ClearPendingMessages(i)) /\ DOMAIN ClearPendingMessages(i) = {m \in DOMAIN pendingMessages : m.msource # i})))
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME IsABag(pendingMessages), NEW i PROVE /\ IsABag(ClearPendingMessages(i)) /\ DOMAIN ClearPendingMessages(i) = {m \in DOMAIN pendingMessages : m.msource # i}
      OBVIOUS
    <2>1. /\ IsABag(PendingMessages(i))
          /\ DOMAIN PendingMessages(i) = {m \in DOMAIN pendingMessages : m.msource = i}
          /\ \A m \in DOMAIN PendingMessages(i) : PendingMessages(i)[m] = pendingMessages[m]
      BY <1>1
    <2>2. /\ IsABag(ClearPendingMessages(i))
          /\ DOMAIN ClearPendingMessages(i)
                = {e \in DOMAIN pendingMessages :
                      e \notin DOMAIN PendingMessages(i)
                      \/ pendingMessages[e] > PendingMessages(i)[e]}
      BY <2>1, ZBagFacts DEF ClearPendingMessages
    <2>3. \A e \in DOMAIN pendingMessages : pendingMessages[e] \in Nat
      BY DEF IsABag
    <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, SMTT("r3")
  <1>3. ((IsABag(pendingMessages)) => ((IsABag(messages)) => (\A i : (/\ IsABag(PendingMessages(i) (+) messages) /\ DOMAIN (PendingMessages(i) (+) messages) = {m \in DOMAIN pendingMessages : m.msource = i} \cup (DOMAIN messages) /\ IsABag(pendingMessages (-) PendingMessages(i)) /\ DOMAIN (pendingMessages (-) PendingMessages(i)) \subseteq DOMAIN pendingMessages))))
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME IsABag(pendingMessages), IsABag(messages), NEW i PROVE /\ IsABag(PendingMessages(i) (+) messages) /\ DOMAIN (PendingMessages(i) (+) messages) = {m \in DOMAIN pendingMessages : m.msource = i} \cup (DOMAIN messages) /\ IsABag(pendingMessages (-) PendingMessages(i)) /\ DOMAIN (pendingMessages (-) PendingMessages(i)) \subseteq DOMAIN pendingMessages
      OBVIOUS
    <2>1. /\ IsABag(PendingMessages(i))
          /\ DOMAIN PendingMessages(i) = {m \in DOMAIN pendingMessages : m.msource = i}
      BY <1>1
    <2> QED BY <2>1, ZBagFacts, ZBagFacts
  <1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3

LEMMA ZMaxFacts ==
  /\ lb1 :: (\A a \in Int : (\A b \in Int : (Max({a,b}) \in {a,b} /\ Max({a,b}) >= a /\ Max({a,b}) >= b)))
  /\ lb2 :: (\A a \in Int : (\A b \in Int : (Min({a,b}) \in {a,b} /\ Min({a,b}) =< a /\ Min({a,b}) =< b)))
  /\ lb3 :: \A n \in Nat : \A S \in SUBSET (1..n) : S # {} => \E x \in S : \A y \in S : x >= y
  /\ lb4 :: (\A n \in Nat : (\A S : ((S \subseteq 1..n) => ((S # {}) => (Max(S) \in S /\ \A y \in S : Max(S) >= y)))))
  <1>1. (\A a \in Int : (\A b \in Int : (Max({a,b}) \in {a,b} /\ Max({a,b}) >= a /\ Max({a,b}) >= b)))
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW a \in Int, NEW b \in Int PROVE Max({a,b}) \in {a,b} /\ Max({a,b}) >= a /\ Max({a,b}) >= b
      OBVIOUS
    <2>1. \E x \in {a,b} : \A y \in {a,b} : x >= y
      BY SMTT("r2")
    <2> QED BY <2>1 DEF Max
  <1>2. (\A a \in Int : (\A b \in Int : (Min({a,b}) \in {a,b} /\ Min({a,b}) =< a /\ Min({a,b}) =< b)))
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW a \in Int, NEW b \in Int PROVE Min({a,b}) \in {a,b} /\ Min({a,b}) =< a /\ Min({a,b}) =< b
      OBVIOUS
    <2>1. \E x \in {a,b} : \A y \in {a,b} : x =< y
      BY SMTT("r2")
    <2> QED BY <2>1 DEF Min
  <1>3. \A n \in Nat : \A S \in SUBSET (1..n) : S # {} => \E x \in S : \A y \in S : x >= y
    <2> DEFINE Q(n) == \A S \in SUBSET (1..n) : S # {} => \E x \in S : \A y \in S : x >= y
    <2>1. Q(0)
      OBVIOUS
    <2>2. \A n \in Nat : Q(n) => Q(n+1)
      <3> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW n \in Nat, Q(n), NEW S \in SUBSET (1..n+1), S # {}
                   PROVE  \E x \in S : \A y \in S : x >= y
        OBVIOUS
      <3>1. CASE n+1 \in S
        BY <3>1, SMTT("r5")
      <3>2. CASE n+1 \notin S
        <4>1. S \in SUBSET (1..n)
          BY <3>2, SMTT("r5")
        <4> QED BY <4>1
      <3> QED BY <3>1, <3>2
    <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2, NatInduction
  <1>4. (\A n \in Nat : (\A S : ((S \subseteq 1..n) => ((S # {}) => (Max(S) \in S /\ \A y \in S : Max(S) >= y)))))
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW n \in Nat, NEW S, S \subseteq 1..n, S # {} PROVE Max(S) \in S /\ \A y \in S : Max(S) >= y
      OBVIOUS
    <2>1. \E x \in S : \A y \in S : x >= y
      BY <1>3
    <2> QED BY <2>1 DEF Max
  <1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4

LEMMA ZQuorumFacts ==
  /\ lb1 :: ((ZTypeOK) => (\A i \in Server : (GetConfig(i) = InitServer /\ GetLearners(i) = {})))
  /\ lb2 :: (\A S \in Quorum(InitServer) : (/\ S \subseteq InitServer /\ IsFiniteSet(S) /\ Cardinality(S) \in Nat /\ Cardinality(S) * 2 > Cardinality(InitServer) /\ S # {}))
  /\ lb3 :: (\A S \in Quorum(InitServer) : (\A T \in Quorum(InitServer) : (\E k \in InitServer : k \in S /\ k \in T)))
  /\ lb4 :: (\A S \in Quorum(InitServer) : (\A j \in InitServer : (S \cup {j} \in Quorum(InitServer))))
  <1>1. ((ZTypeOK) => (\A i \in Server : (GetConfig(i) = InitServer /\ GetLearners(i) = {})))
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME ZTypeOK, NEW i \in Server PROVE GetConfig(i) = InitServer /\ GetLearners(i) = {}
      OBVIOUS
    <2>1. config[i] = ZConf
      BY DEF ZTypeOK
    <2>2. GetJointConfig(i) = <<InitServer, {}>>
      BY <2>1 DEF GetJointConfig, ZConf
    <2>3. <<InitServer, {}>>[1] = InitServer
      OBVIOUS
    <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3 DEF GetConfig, GetLearners, ZConf
  <1>2. (\A S \in Quorum(InitServer) : (/\ S \subseteq InitServer /\ IsFiniteSet(S) /\ Cardinality(S) \in Nat /\ Cardinality(S) * 2 > Cardinality(InitServer) /\ S # {}))
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW S \in Quorum(InitServer) PROVE /\ S \subseteq InitServer /\ IsFiniteSet(S) /\ Cardinality(S) \in Nat /\ Cardinality(S) * 2 > Cardinality(InitServer) /\ S # {}
      OBVIOUS
    <2>1. S \subseteq InitServer /\ Cardinality(S) * 2 > Cardinality(InitServer)
      BY DEF Quorum
    <2>2. IsFiniteSet(S)
      BY <2>1, FiniteServers, ZFinFacts
    <2>3. Cardinality(S) \in Nat /\ Cardinality(InitServer) \in Nat
      BY <2>2, FiniteServers, ZFinFacts
    <2>4. S # {}
      BY <2>1, <2>3, ZFinFacts, SMTT("r3")
    <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4
  <1>3. (\A S \in Quorum(InitServer) : (\A T \in Quorum(InitServer) : (\E k \in InitServer : k \in S /\ k \in T)))
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW S \in Quorum(InitServer), NEW T \in Quorum(InitServer) PROVE \E k \in InitServer : k \in S /\ k \in T
      OBVIOUS
    <2>1. /\ S \subseteq InitServer /\ Cardinality(S) \in Nat
          /\ Cardinality(S) * 2 > Cardinality(InitServer)
      BY <1>2
    <2>2. /\ T \subseteq InitServer /\ Cardinality(T) \in Nat
          /\ Cardinality(T) * 2 > Cardinality(InitServer)
      BY <1>2
    <2>3. Cardinality(InitServer) \in Nat
      BY FiniteServers, ZFinFacts
    <2>4. Cardinality(S) + Cardinality(T) > Cardinality(InitServer)
      BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, SMTT("r5")
